note: No queryable zoning district polygon layer found for Yalobusha County or its largest city, Water Valley. The county GIS map (localgreenstone.com/YalobushaMS) is a viewer that could not be opened or verified to serve zoning. The state 2024 parcel layer lists ZONING as not available. Water Valley publishes only a 2006 Zoning and Development Ordinance as a document, with no district layer. Coffeeville and Oakland were not found to publish zoning layers.
